rss: Home sellers cut asking prices on 3,000 properties a day
title: Toy Brick Prices Drop Big Time!
story: More people are selling their toy bricks for lower prices. This means you can buy toy bricks cheaper than before!
storyBig: The toy brick market is seeing a significant decrease in prices, with sellers adjusting their prices to attract more buyers. This trend reflects an oversupply situation where the market is saturated with more toy bricks than there is demand.
think: Why might people lower the price of something they're selling?
bull: You can get more toy bricks for your money!
bear: The value of your toy bricks might go down too.

rss: Musk and Anthropic pledge public share giveaways
title: Pizza Palace Gives Free Pizza Shares!
story: Pizza Palace is giving away free shares to people! This means you can own a little part of the company.
storyBig: Pizza Palace has announced a public share giveaway, allowing enthusiasts to gain a small ownership stake in the company. This move is intended to increase public engagement and potentially raise interest in the company's upcoming stock market listing.
think: What would you do if you owned a small part of a company?
bull: You could become a part-owner of Pizza Palace!
bear: The shares might not be worth much if the company doesn't do well.
